reply.rationale: No defensible multi-entry compositional paradigm survives the evidence tests. The numbered T1–T14 and P1–P5 forms fail the opaque index test: the numerals do not contribute literal count/sequence meaning compositionally, but instead select unrelated stored procedures/motifs. The candidate string-overlap families (T1-/cor-/ -rm/ -int) likewise lack a coherent shared morphotactic frame with stable compositional meanings for their residues. Although g/s and f/d/i are standalone semantic labels, there are no attested multi-morpheme codes in which they alternate inside a shared frame, so no construction can be justified. To avoid false morphology, all supplied symbols are treated as lexical.
